title: No-overdraft checking explained
summary: Explains how “no-overdraft” checking works: transactions that would push available balance negative are declined at authorization; overdraft protection transfers are not used and the transfer fee is $0.00. Cashier’s check requests require sufficient available funds (issuer fee: 8); otherwise the request isn’t completed. Card purchases and ATM withdrawals authorize only up to available balance; over-funds charges are declined immediately with no overdraft and no transfer assessed ($0.00).
